items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Babe Russin, "All the Things You Are", "Like Someone In Love."

ctx.x: In the Forties and Fifties. But most of these, I would say, were in the Forties. Babe Russin, "All the Things You Are", "Like Someone In Love." And Andre Previn.
You were telling me a few minutes ago, before we turned the tape on, that you were on Andre Previn's first record.
